channel.title: Abdullah Al Fahim · Blog
channel.description: Broadcast technology, app development, design systems, brand identity, research, leadership and AI for design.

item.title: Logos With a Second Meaning: FedEx, Amazon, Baskin-Robbins, Toblerone and Why Hidden Symbols Work
item.description: An arrow between two letters. A smile that points from A to Z. A number hidden in initials. Why the best hidden symbols in logos work, and how to use negative space in your own designs without making a puzzle.

item.title: The Week Nusrat Said Yes to Everything
item.description: Nusrat is the designer who never says no: to her boss, to the sales team, to her cousin's wedding card. Then one Thursday night in Banani, everything she promised comes due at once. A Friday story about the overcommitment trap.

item.title: What a 24/7 Control Room Teaches About Calm Leadership
item.description: A Master Control Room never closes, never pauses and never gets a second take. Here is what running live transmission at Channel i has taught me about staying calm, and helping a team stay calm, when the stakes are on air.

item.title: Colour Profiles Explained: sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, Rec.709 and CMYK in One Cheat Sheet
item.description: Which colour profile should you export for the web, social media, print and video? A plain-language guide to sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, Rec.709 and CMYK (FOGRA/SWOP), with a decision flowchart.

item.title: Case Study: Building khanfarhana.info, a Brand, a Community and an Academy in One WordPress Theme
item.description: How I designed and hand-coded one WordPress theme that holds a personal brand, a fellowship, an opportunities board, a press room and a full learning platform with payments, and that her team runs without a developer.

item.title: Running an MCR Like a High-Reliability Operation: Shift Handovers, SOPs and Checklists That Prevent On-Air Errors
item.description: Hospitals, airlines and power plants learned how to avoid disasters with handovers, checklists and a healthy fear of failure. A Master Control Room can borrow every one of those habits.

item.title: Inside a Master Control Room: How a TV Channel Stays on Air 24/7
item.description: What actually happens between a playlist and your television screen, and the habits that keep a 24-hour channel from going dark.

item.title: AI in My Design Workflow: Where It Helps and Where It Doesn't
item.description: A practical look at using AI tools for briefs, research, ideation, image editing and code, plus the parts of design I still won't hand over.

item.title: Building a Personal Design System from One Colour
item.description: How one violet, one highlight colour and two typefaces became the rules behind my website, GitHub profile, CV and apps.

item.title: Making Alarms Reliable on Android: Lessons from Building TaskBell
item.description: Exact alarms, Doze, battery savers, reboots and time zones: what it takes for a reminder app to ring at the right second, every time.

item.title: Designing Bilingual Brands: Setting Bangla and English Together
item.description: Why Bangla and English type rarely match out of the box, and the practical rules I use to make them feel like one brand.

item.title: Moving from SDI to IP Workflows (SMPTE ST 2110): Planning, Risks and a Phased Migration Roadmap for Bangladesh
item.description: Most Bangladeshi TV channels still run on SDI cables built a decade or more ago. Here is how a channel in Dhaka can plan a move to SMPTE ST 2110: what it changes, the local risks, and a phased roadmap that never puts the on-air signal at risk.

item.title: Brand Identity Is More Than a Logo: A Practical Process for Small Organisations
item.description: The step-by-step process I use with startups, youth organisations and shops to go from a vague brief to an identity people can actually use.

item.title: Design Theory You Can Use Tomorrow: Gestalt, Hierarchy and Simple Research
item.description: The handful of design principles and research methods I actually use every week, explained without the jargon.

item.title: Building Offline-First Apps for Bangladesh
item.description: Why my apps work without the internet, keep data on the phone and speak Bangla first, and the design and engineering choices that follow.

item.title: Leading Volunteer Creative Teams: What Student Organisations Taught Me
item.description: Lessons from leading design teams and events in student and youth organisations, where nobody is paid and everyone is busy.
